scope: Native exact-parent reader correctness only; no deployment or performance claim
limits: An active lease is move-only, single-worker and relies on stable Reader/Eth/Snapshots/Store lifetimes.
Native synchronous MDBX operations check cancellation at method/batch boundaries, not within an individual database call.
Read-only separate-process live-writer qualification belongs to the constructor harness; library tests validate readonly reopen and same-environment writer MVCC changes.
The reader admits 32 leases; the owner must additionally bound lease lifetime and caller scratch memory.
